user.title: Feed-in Optimiser
user.description: Plans battery charging and discharging to minimise your electricity bill. This integration is advisory only — it publishes a recommended plan and never controls your battery.

data.load_sensor: House load power sensor (for learning your usage pattern)
data.reserve_soc: Reserve state of charge (never plan below this)

data_description.reserve_soc: A hard floor. The plan will never discharge below this level.
data_description.horizon_hours: 48 hours is recommended so the planner can see past tomorrow's cheap-power window; a shorter horizon makes it hoard energy instead of exporting when prices are high.
data_description.cycle_cost_per_kwh: Prices battery wear. Also stops the planner cycling the battery pointlessly when export prices are zero. 0.01 is a sensible starting point.

abort.already_configured: The Feed-in Optimiser is already set up.
